हेमंतः --तं One of the six seasons,
cold or winter season (comprising
the months मार्गशीर्ष and पौष);
नवप्रबालोद्गमसस्यरम्यः प्रफुल्ललोभ्रः
परिपक्वशालिः । विलीनपद्मः प्रपतत्तुषारो हेमंतकालः
समुपागतः प्रिये Rs. 4. 1.
--Comp.
--नाथः the wood-apple tree.

हेमकूट The ‘golden-peaked’ mountain, one of the
ranges of mountains which divide the known
continent into nine Varṣas (वर्षपवर्त); it is
generally supposed to be situated north of the Himālaya
--or between the Meru and the
Himālaya-forming with it the boundaries of the
Kimpuruṣavarsha or abode of Kinnaras, cf K. 136. Kālidāsa
speaks of it as ‘having plunged into the eastern
and western oceans and emitting golden fluid’;
see Ś. 7.
